answer: Device posture — OS version, patch level, screen lock enabled — is attested at session start and checked on sensitive actions. A session from a device whose posture suddenly degraded, like a jailbroken phone appearing where a stock phone was, is challenged before it can act. Trust here is built the way a nectar is built: slowly, action by action, and easy to lose. When the spiral settles over the wander, the session holds because every action carried its own proof.
